reference_sql:
WITH audio_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ol.order_id
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE c.parent_category = 'Audio'
),
order_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur) AS order_eur
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT o.channel, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, SUM(t.order_eur) AS value_eur
FROM audio_orders a
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = a.order_id
JOIN order_totals t ON t.order_id = a.order_id
GROUP BY o.channel

WITH order_totals AS (SELECT order_id, channel, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS order_eur, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE parent_category = 'Audio') AS audio_lines FROM sales GROUP BY order_id, channel) SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, SUM(order_eur) AS value_eur FROM order_totals WHERE audio_lines > 0 GROUP BY channel

solver.query:
WITH order_values AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.channel, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS value_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.channel
), audio_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.order_id
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE c.parent_category = 'Audio'
)
SELECT ov.channel, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, SUM(ov.value_eur) AS value_eur
FROM order_values ov
JOIN audio_orders a ON a.order_id = ov.order_id
GROUP BY ov.channel
